title: MoveObjectPlan
description: A retry-safe execution plan for a single move_object mutation. This is the MCP request contract. It carries absolute world-space endpoints, not just a relative delta, so execution can distinguish 'not yet applied' from 'already applied' from 'the scene changed underneath us'. A blind `location += delta` is unsafe across a crash/retry window: if the move was applied and saved but completion was never recorded, replaying the delta would double the movement. desired_after_meters must equal expected_before_meters + delta_meters; JSON Schema cannot express that arithmetic, so the service verifies it with the same documented position tolerance used everywhere else. The plan contains fully resolved canonical meters only — no units, no direction tokens, no natural language.

job_id.description: Identity of the job this execution belongs to, echoed in the result for correlation.

expected_before_meters.description: World-space position the plan was computed against.

delta_meters.description: The semantic movement, in canonical meters.
